description: Board = flowtype 'case'. Fresh-case draft scaffold + the status-column pattern. Created via POST /flow/2/{acct}/case?_application_id={app} with {Name, ItemType:'Board'|'Case', Prefix} — born Live, no publish step. Captured live 2026-08-12 (#49).
notes: Create body: {"Name":..., "ItemType":"Board"|"Case", "Prefix":"PB"} — ItemType and Prefix are MANDATORY (400 MissingRequiredFieldError without them). Both ItemType values produce byte-identical graphs; it echoes verbatim on flow-detail, looks cosmetic. Response: {_id, Type:"Case", Status:"Live"} — born Live, same as a list flow.

The platform-scaffolded nodes on a REAL fresh case use FLAT ids (Summary, Description, Attachment, Column001, Row001Column001) — NOT the Field_/Column_/Row_ prefix convention. Nodes added afterward DO use the prefix convention; both coexist in one graph. This template mints Sample ids for the blindness/shape contract — the flat-id reality is the finding, remember it before running graph.py helpers that assume prefixed ids against a case draft.

NO style chain (Model::Appearance -> Appearance -> Appearance::Style -> Style) exists on a fresh case, unlike process/form where an incomplete chain breaks render. Whether the builder needs one on a case is UNVERIFIED (no UI open in the capture).

NO ProcessDef anywhere in the case draft. Flow-detail instead carries: built-in Priority enum (Critical/High/Medium/Low, Low Default:true), _disabled_category:["Done","ReOpened"] (implies a platform-native Open/InProgress/Done/ReOpened lifecycle), _default_workflow_id:<case_id>_flow (a satellite object that 403s on every draft route even for the creating key — board workflow is UNCAPTURED, not proven absent), _field_permission_mapping:<case_id>_permission (unexplored), CaseView:[] and PinnedViews:[] (board-view config surface).

There is NO 'Grid' field type on this write path — a board status column is an ordinary Select + ReferredList (Field_Sample04 here; copilot silently substitutes exactly this and the referenced list flow is created + filled with the option strings). The 6-unit row packing rule applies on a case identically to process/form.

Member surface: same member/batch route shape, but Role enum = Admin | Member (DataAdmin/User/etc. rejected with RoleDoesNotExistError). Every guessed Permission literal 400s UnsupportedPermissionError; only Permission:[] returns 200 — presumptively the same silent no-op trap as process. The real case Permission vocabulary is UNCAPTURED — harvest from the builder UI network tab.

Copilot FABRICATED a success on this module: claimed a Kanban view with a concrete-sounding view id while CaseView stayed [] and zero graph keys changed. Not reply-lag — a false claim. Diff the graph AND flow-detail CaseView/Report arrays after every claimed board change.
Application archive CASCADES to every child flow/page/system report in one call; delete then succeeds. Verify via the inventory route, never the delete response.
